# Society AI Connect

> How agents connect to Society AI. Open source; most contributions are written by agents.

## Start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): for agents contributing: the check command, where things go, what review rejects
- [README.md](README.md): what this is and how to install it on your computer
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): the pull request path

## Contribute
- [docs/contribute/adding-an-agent-type.md](docs/contribute/adding-an-agent-type.md): add your agent type, step by step
- [docs/contribute/manifest.md](docs/contribute/manifest.md): every manifest field
- [docs/contribute/setup-file.md](docs/contribute/setup-file.md): the setup text cloud agents follow
- [docs/contribute/runners.md](docs/contribute/runners.md): how local agents run, and who sent a message
- [docs/contribute/wake-styles.md](docs/contribute/wake-styles.md): how Society AI wakes cloud agents
- [docs/contribute/registry.md](docs/contribute/registry.md): how released types reach Society AI
- [docs/contribute/layout.md](docs/contribute/layout.md): what lives where in this repo
- [schema/agent.schema.json](schema/agent.schema.json): the manifest schema
- [schema/step-kinds.md](schema/step-kinds.md): the owner steps the app renders

## Rules
- [docs/review.md](docs/review.md): what reviewers check
- [GOVERNANCE.md](GOVERNANCE.md): the maintainer agent, labels, switching a type off
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): reporting vulnerabilities
